title: HOLD-LC-001 rsp2 binary-table segment index and selection ambiguity envelope
question: What exact response-history segment structure and candidate-neutral selection alternatives are available before a source-owned validity/interpolation and timing-uncertainty rule is admitted?
purpose: Additive binary-table owner intake only; preserve T-054, T-059 and T-061 methods, owner order and promotion firewalls.

selection_alternatives.covering: closed TSTART/TSTOP interval, with zero-duration endpoint rule
selection_alternatives.nearest: minimum absolute distance to (TSTART+TSTOP)/2, smallest RSP_NUM tie break
selection_alternatives.interpolation_bracket: adjacent ordered centers and linear weights; outside domain is NONE

theorem_or_checks: Exact byte and length identity against the response-history manifest.
FITS binary-table row layout and channel/energy monotonicity.
P-descriptor nonempty and heap-bound checks without following heap arrays.
Candidate-neutral covering, nearest and center-bracket alternatives with weights in [0,1] summing to one.
assumptions: The parent response-history manifest remains authoritative for identity, locators, byte lengths and SHA-256 values.
FITS scalar/table declarations and P-descriptors can be read with the declared big-endian layout without interpreting response coefficients.
The fixed query grid is a reproducibility fixture and is not fitted or used to tune a candidate.
The existing T-054 forward and T-059/T-061 inverse methods, owner order and promotion firewalls remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: Source-owned response-validity/interpolation rule tied to event and spectral-history windows.
Detector-to-geocenter propagation conversion with uncertainty and a common time standard.
Frozen detector, energy, background and temporal windows with source-owned selection semantics.
Joint timing likelihood or shared/component covariance with calibration and intrinsic-emission nuisance terms.
Complete candidate-neutral F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, immutable scorer and prospective holdout.

adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED by NONE_SELECTED and hostile mutations.

Promote finite metadata to microscopic dynamics or Yang--Mills evidence

evidence_level: T0 exact public-product bytes plus finite binary-table structure and selection-ambiguity metadata
non_claims: No response alternative is selected and no response coefficient is read or interpreted.
No calibration validity, timing conversion, uncertainty, likelihood, covariance, nuisance law, candidate score or holdout prediction is admitted.
No microscopic dynamics, causal propagation, physical sector, Pre-A, QFT, Yang--Mills, gravity, continuum or mass-gap conclusion follows.

boundary: Finite response-history segment metadata and unselected alternatives only; source-owned validity/interpolation, timing uncertainty, likelihood, covariance, nuisance, complete map, prospective holdout, physical identity and continuum remain open.
next_action: Hash-pin the source-owned validity/interpolation and timing-uncertainty rules. Keep all alternatives, response coefficients and scoring locked until the owner contract is complete.
